fields.statement: At 93c41166, go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogGreenUnmerged -v passes TestWatchdogGreenUnmerged and TestWatchdogGreenUnmergedReadsOnce. With a fake gh read (watchdogDeps.ci) and no merge dep, the pass resumes (--retry via queueContinue) only the autonomous run failed at its merge step, leaves the live run at merge alone, and holds the succeeded-unmerged run and the run gated by a signoff as inbox items with no resume and no merge call; red/absent checks or no open PR do nothing, and a spent budget holds.
